description: Far from the slimes you're used to, this marketable plushie looks more like a giant, slightly flattened droplet of light blue gelatin. An expression of perfect relaxation and a cute pair of blushing dots adorn its jiggly royal figure. It takes only a glance to hear the words, "I'm not a bad slime...!"

Far from the skeletal undead you're used to, this is a marketable plush of a skeleton dressed in a black and purple robe, the epitome of regality. He carries with him an air of death--instant and final. You find no mercy, only infinite wisdom and absolute strategy in those two red flame eyes.

It is a surprisingly detailed plushie of a steel broadsword, the blue eye adorning the center of its crossguard staring ever on. A stiff blue tassel stems from the pommel like a prehensile tail with four-fingers, using them to grip onto an attached ancient scabbard. In all... the ultimate weapon for a pillow fight.

A body-sized pillow with a print of a golden-eyed, light blue-haired anime girl holding a small blue slime above her head, and on the back... Nevermind. Even with there being slime absolutely everywhere, there's nothing to hide the fact that neither sets of "tools" are "equipped".

A body-sized pillow with a print of a blue-eyed, blonde haired girl with impressive proportions on the front, though not quite as impressive as the anti-tank rifle she clings to. On the back of the pillow, her slightly skimpy yellow police uniform, white thighighs, and eyes have all turned blood-red. It depicts her with her mouth parted and tongue out, looking ready to receieve... uh.... Blood, surely.

A body-sized pillow with a print of a dark-violet-haired woman wearing a tight black sleeveless dress and red jacket. On the front, her hand is on her hip with a confident gesture, while on the back she's posed provocatively, trading in her dress for a loosely-laced black swimsuit, pistol in her hand as she gives you a judging look.

A body-sized pillow with a print of a... a janitor. He's an older gentleman, and judging by the questionable magazine in his hand, doesn't seem very reputable. ...Are you sure you even want to see what's on the back?

A profoundly large pillow with a print of a rather dashing queen, dressed in black, seated upon a jagged black throne with her legs crossed. She has a spiked reptilian tail, shell, and a pair of horns, yet on the back of the pillows she's-oHMIGOD

A body-sized pillow with a print of a grizzled, silver-haired mercenary dressed in a skin-tight sneaking suit. You can't help but feel that he doesn't look very solid. That is, until you it around and find a much younger, yet nuder, and undoubtedly far more 'solid' mercenary greeting you as he crawls out from the underside of a carboard box.
